payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the practical application of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity set expansion (ESE) methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: The MAP at gold-k (k g ) metric is designed to evaluate ESE methods in scenarios where coverage of diverse entity types is crucial, particularly in user-generated text.
Using MAP at gold-k allows for adaptation to varying concept sizes and provides a better estimate of recall, which is essential for assessing effectiveness in real-world applications.
Evaluation at k g reveals performance drops of ESE methods, indicating that existing metrics may overestimate their effectiveness, especially in user-generated contexts.
